title: I-PAttnGAN: An Image-Assisted Point Cloud Completion Network Based on Attention GAN
content: Ensuring the consistency and accuracy of point cloud data is crucial for building 3D scenes. However, obtaining dense and uniformly distributed features is challenging due to limitations in LiDAR hardware. The presence of sparse regions increases the workload and redundancy of subsequent tasks. To address this issue, we propose I-PAttnGAN, a network that generates point clouds based on images with the aim of improving density and uniformity in sparse areas. By integrating image and point cloud data, I-PAttnGAN dynamically extracts attention weights focused on point cloud density using a normalization flow model to learn the relationship between image features and point cloud distribution. This enables adaptive generation of dense point clouds. We conducted extensive experiments using ShapeNet and NuScenes datasets, which demonstrated that our proposed I-PAttnGAN outperforms existing methods, particularly in generating high-quality dense point clouds in low-density areas: CD values significantly reduced by approximately two times, EMD values increased by 1.3 times, and F1 scores improved by 1.5 times. Meanwhile, we also conducted ablation experiments to verify the newly added modules, and the results show that our model played a critical role in the generation process. We demonstrate significant advantages of our model in terms of accuracy and efficiency for generating complete spatial point clouds.
